candidateValue.plain: State 0 is some x0. State t+1 consumes the whole current loss t and current stepsize t, matching source round t+1; it is played after that loss is received. The selector has no horizon, comparator or future loss input. Prefix equality concerns entire loss functions at indices below t. In a complete real inner-product space, suppose V is convex and states t and t+1 of this same recursion return x and p. Require positive current eta, a proper current loss with a global supporting subgradient at every feasible point, and differentiability of psi at both x and p. Then every u in V satisfies eta*((loss p).toReal-(loss u).toReal) <= D(u;x)-D(u;p)-D(p;x). Proper means no negative infinity and a finite ambient witness; each support compares every ambient point. These premises make all compared feasible loss values finite. No loss differentiability, psi convexity, boundedness, or x in V is assumed. Both signed negative residuals remain.
